statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null; if git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$branch" ] && branch=$(git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$(git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then dirty="dirty"; else dirty="clean"; fi; ab=$(git --no-optional-locks rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD' 2>/dev/null); abs=""; if [ -n "$ab" ]; then behind=$(echo "$ab" | awk '{print $1}'); ahead=$(echo "$ab" | awk '{print $2}'); [ "$ahead" != "0" ] && abs="$abs ^$ahead"; [ "$behind" != "0" ] && abs="$abs v$behind"; fi; printf '\033[2m%s\033[0m | \033[2mgit:(%s%s) %s\033[0m' "$model" "$branch" "$abs" "$dirty"; else printf '\033[2m%s\033[0m | \033[2mno git repo\033[0m' "$model"; fi
